inputs.text: John Lahart, a Fianna Fáil TD from Dublin South-West, is demanding major changes to inheritance tax exemptions. He insists the current rules are ‘wholly unfair’ because they discriminate against people without children. Some of his party colleagues are also pushing to review the tax so it fits different family structures. This is just more progressive nonsense meant to undermine our traditional values. Those exemptions were put there to strengthen families by letting parents pass on their wealth and responsibility to their children, not to impose some phony equality that overlooks the real sacrifices parents make. We need to stand firm and defend family structures from these attacks.
